about: Colors as data. `accents` are the named accent themes (HSL), `default` the one used unless a card asks for another, `base` the CSS color variables of the dark glass look (text colors ink / foreground included), `schemes` what changes when the page behind is dark, light or mid, `chart-ink` the RGB the chart canvases draw their text in on dark or light cards. Override any key in your prefs/ui.json under "themes"; the host reloads this file by itself when it changes. `platforms.<os>` (mac, win) is laid over the rest on that system: its own default accent, accents, base and schemes. `skin` names a material set the CSS keys off (html[data-skin=...]): none = the default plates; `glass` = see-through tint, grain, glints and dark lens pills (on macOS over native Liquid Glass). To swap the accent: set `default` (or platforms.<os>.default, or prefs/ui.json themes.default) to any name in `accents`, or add your own; every accent-colored thing (buttons, badges, the pin nub, the glass lens lines and glow) follows it. `skin` can be several words, laid on in order: `"glass"` or `"glass flat"` (no texture). `tone-*` (base): the named colours a button can pick in its card JSON ("tone": "green"); no tone = the accent. `tone-cycle` (base): filled buttons with no tone take these in order, one per button in a card (the first stays the accent).

mac.about: macOS: the glass skin over native Liquid Glass (src/platform/macos/glass.rs) in the coral scheme: warm dark surfaces and tints, coral accent (user, 10 Nov night: copy the coral scheme, darker glints). Mostly dark: a dark page keeps dark surfaces here. The plate stays neutral dark (user: no orange plate); the coral is deeper on Mac (14 70% 54%) and only a faint trace reaches the plate edge (edge-a).

win.about: Windows 11: the fluent skin, always dark (a bright page behind keeps dark surfaces, like macOS), accent 'sky' (the light Windows 11 blue). Set default to 'ember' for a light orange, or 'system' for your Windows accent.

glass.about: Dark glass: a see-through tint with dark grain, glints and a soft light that follows the pointer (macOS: over native Liquid Glass), and dark lens pills inside (rows, badges, plain buttons: black rim, thin grey line, white text). Turn it on with `skin: "glass"` (top level, per platform, or in prefs/ui.json under themes). Sizes: ui/tokens/lens.json. Charts and graphs: a palette walking 200 deg from the accent (pie slices, line gradient), lightness steady (user, 11-10: more colors in pie and line charts).

flat.about: A variant word for the glass skin: `skin: "glass flat"` keeps the glass and drops the texture (grain, glints, pointer light). CSS: html[data-skin~="flat"].

fluent.about: Windows 11 (Fluent, dark): acrylic under the plate (src/platform/windows/glass.rs), 8px card corners and 4px controls, Segoe UI Variable, thin light strokes, a filled accent button and quiet standard buttons, card rows with a soft fill, the system accent (accents.system, read from Windows by the host). Sizes: ui/tokens/fluent.json; styles: ui/components/fluent/.
